CAUSAL_ATTRIBUTION_LIMIT_do_not_overclai.what_is_licensed: The repaired pipeline CAN produce strong Pole-A-side specialization. Comparing two sealed evaluations of the same protocol at the same sample size: the sealed pre-repair B3-3 crossover had delta_A = +0.0469 [-0.0703, +0.1563] (FAIL), and this post-repair run has delta_A = +0.3516 [+0.2422, +0.4609] (PASS).
CAUSAL_ATTRIBUTION_LIMIT_do_not_overclai.what_is_NOT_licensed: That the entity stream ALONE causally produced the entire delta_A improvement. pi_A3/pi_B3 received 1,000,000 fresh optimization steps on top of the B3-3 weights; the pre-repair baseline did not receive those steps. No matched 'B3-3 weights + 1,000,000 further steps, entity stream ABSENT' continuation control was run.
CAUSAL_ATTRIBUTION_LIMIT_do_not_overclai.what_would_separate_them: a continuation control: warm-start from the SAME sealed B3-3 checkpoints, same fresh 1,000,000-step budget, same seeds, --entity-repair-enabled OMITTED, then the identical crossover protocol. Cost is the same as this run (~3.5 h/policy training + ~6 h eval on the current GPU).
CAUSAL_ATTRIBUTION_LIMIT_do_not_overclai.why_it_is_deferred_not_dismissed: the immediate engineering question -- WHERE does the remaining failure live -- is answered by Pole-B diagnosis on checkpoints already paid for, and does not depend on resolving this confound. The control is REQUIRED before any publication-grade causal claim about delta_A, and is recorded here as outstanding rather than quietly skipped.
CAUSAL_ATTRIBUTION_LIMIT_do_not_overclai.also_note: the two evaluations used disjoint seed blocks (16700001-16700128 pre-repair vs 17800001-17800128 post-repair), so the comparison above is between two independent sealed estimates, not a paired contrast.
